title: Inventor award: first disclosure approved for a US patent filing
summary: IBM approved my first invention disclosure for filing with the US patent office and gave me its inventor award.
the_call: Turn a product observation into a patentable invention.
what_i_did: Wrote the disclosure 'Determining and conveying availability'.
what_changed: Approved for US filing in July 2010; filed that December; granted as US patent 8,560,487.
